# Example groups are data, and a record can list a second group

## Context

[Map v2](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6918253093) sorts the examples into 22 groups in four bands. **The group list is bound.** On Mon 16 Nov 2026 the operator was asked "Bind the 22-group list of map v2 now, so #21141 can start today?" and answered "Bind now". The Portal knows seven families, of which five publish. A leaf of #21140, for the Engine 14 cut on Mon 23 Nov.

## The Problem

- `familyDefinitions` lists Featured, Grid & Table, Forms, Multi-Window, Calendar, Components and State & Data. Tree, Tab Container, Containers & Layouts, Dashboard & Docking and twelve more groups of the map have no entry.
- A record has one `family`. A drag demonstration lives in Tabs, Lists or Dashboard and belongs in Drag & Drop too; Form layout belongs in Forms and in Layouts. An `alsoIn` list was proposed on 10 Nov, 11 Nov and 16 Nov and never filed: no field in `Portal.model.Example`, none in `examples.json` (read on dev at `459371e353`; no record carries the key at `e338e1ae4a`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainer.mjs`: `familyDefinitions`, the one ordered source of family, title, route and icon; `createFamilyItem()` builds a store per family over the section's catalog.
- `apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainerController.mjs`: `onCatalogLoad()` publishes a family that has a covered record (#21124, on dev).
- `apps/portal/model/Example.mjs`, `apps/portal/store/Examples.mjs`, `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` (77 records).
- `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs` copies the publication rule for the family routes. #21129 (open, Vega) adds `scheduler`, `gantt` and `board`, the search titles in `EXAMPLE_FAMILY_SEO`, and a spec that keeps the defined families and that table's keys equal. It touches the same files and lands first.
- Design authority: the group list is the operator's, bound on 16 Nov (above). The ids, paths, home rules and first `alsoIn` values below are the design seat's; they stay amendable in this leaf's review until the cut.

**What this alone changes for a visitor:** with today's 30 covers, 14 groups have a covered member a production build can open and publish, against four families and Featured today. In Dev mode it is 13: `liquid-glass`, the one covered member of `components`, is hidden there, and a rule that reads the cover alone would publish an empty tab. `realworld` and `realworld-v2` are covered and hidden in every mode. The 14: `grid-table`, `forms`, `calendar`, `tabs`, `dashboard`, `drag-drop`, `lists`, `dialogs`, `charts`, `components`, `multi-window`, `state`, `platform`, `apps`.

## The Fix

1. **Group definitions:** the 22 groups above, each with id, band, title, path and icon. The shape also carries one sentence and the record whose cover is the group's tile; the design seat posts both per group on this ticket with the overview's look (#21130), and the pull request that is open then takes them.
2. **`alsoIn`:** a string list on the model. A group's store holds its home records and the records that name it. A record counts once in every total.
3. **Publication, one predicate:** a member publishes a card in a build mode when it names a cover and that mode can open it: not `hidden`, the mode not in `hiddenIn`, and a URL for the mode. That is the clause `Portal.view.examples.List` applies at render time today (`List.mjs:263`), while the stores and the tab publication read the cover alone. The list, the group stores and the tab publication read one predicate; a group shows while one member passes it and follows the build control; the build writes a route for a group that publishes in production. A group made only of `alsoIn` members (Drag & Drop) follows the same rule. #21129 brings the `hidden` clause (Vega's note of 16 Nov, 16:17Z); the two mode clauses land here.
4. **One data pass:** every record's `family` becomes its home group by the table; the 23 moves and the `alsoIn` values as listed. A record that lands from #20824 or #21105 before this merges moves by the same table; one that lands later takes its group at its own merge.
5. **Search titles:** `EXAMPLE_FAMILY_SEO` gains a row per new group on #21129's pattern, so that its key-equality spec holds; the SEO steward reads the new titles in review.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The group definitions of `Portal.view.examples.TabContainer` | the bound list above | one ordered source of the 22 groups with band, sentence and tile record | none | the class JSDoc | unit |
| `Portal.model.Example#alsoIn` | this ticket | optional list of group ids; default empty | a record without it behaves as today | the field's JSDoc | unit |
| `/examples/{group}` | #20690's ledger | existing paths unchanged; a new group gets its id as path | an unknown or unpublished group opens the section root `/examples` (Featured today, the overview after #21130) | none | unit, e2e |
| `seo.json` group routes | #21129 | follow the same publication rule | none | none | the pin spec of #21129, extended |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The definitions hold the 22 bound groups in the bound order, and nothing else in the Portal names a group's title, path or icon. `EXAMPLE_FAMILY_SEO` keeps its search titles, keyed by group id.
- [ ] After the data pass every record has a home group from the table; the 23 moves and the `alsoIn` values are as listed; Featured lists the same 28 records as before.
- [ ] A record with `alsoIn` appears in its home group and in each named group, once each, and is counted once in the catalog's totals.
- [ ] A group with no member that publishes a card in the active build mode, home or `alsoIn`, shows no entry; a group that publishes none in production gets no route in `seo.json`. A spec pins the published set per mode over a fixture catalog; on the catalog of `e338e1ae4a` it is the 14 groups named above in three modes and 13 in Dev mode, without `components`.
- [ ] `Portal.view.examples.List` hides a card through the same predicate; its own clause is gone.
- [ ] Every path defined on dev today still resolves, the four build routes included; an unknown or unpublished group opens `/examples`.
- [ ] Unit cases cover each row of the ledger; the spec that feeds one set of rows to the view and to `seoJson.mjs` covers `alsoIn`.
- [ ] The new and changed members carry JSDoc with `@summary`.

## Out of Scope

How the overview and the group navigation render (#21130); covers; records for unpublished examples; the choice of which examples a group shows (#21142); where the Featured selection stands once the overview exists (#21130).

## Avoided Traps

- **One boolean per group on the record.** Featured is the existing second mark; a 23rd group must cost one definition, not a model field.
- **A copy of a record per group.** Totals, routes and captions drift apart.
- **Renaming `/examples/grid`.** It is the delivered overview and the path crawlers know.
- **Moving an app to Apps because it is an app.** A record's home is where a visitor looks for its claim: the four multi-window apps and the form app keep their home and are listed in Apps through `alsoIn`. Otherwise Multi-Window drops from seven covered cards to two.
- **Reading a folder name as a group.** `component/mwc` wraps Google's Material components; the inventory first counted it as Multi-Window.

### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-11-16T17:48:51Z

Claimed. Intake ran against `dev` and against #21129's head `782cbc60d0`, which lands first.

- Epic review: @neo-gpt-euclid's on #21140 (15:07Z).
- Prescription checked: `apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainer.mjs` owns the definitions and the publish rule. `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs` reads both from that file's source with a literal-only parser, so every new definition field stays a literal.

Two sharpenings I'll carry into the build unless the design seat objects:
1. `Portal.view.examples.List#isHiddenItem` has a fourth clause beside the three catalog clauses: the Portal's own record hides when its build's environment is the running one, a link to the page itself. That clause depends on the running page, not the catalog, so it stays in `List`. The three catalog clauses move into the shared predicate.
2. With the mode in the predicate, a group tab follows the build control. Switching to Dev mode removes Components while `liquid-glass` is its only covered member there. The controller therefore re-publishes on a `catalogMode` change as well as on load.

On naming, the code keeps `family` for the home-group field and `familyDefinitions` for the list, since 77 records, the SEO extractor and their specs read them; the JSDoc names them as the map's groups. The PR follows #21129's merge, before Thu 19 Nov.
